decision.title: Choices try every alternative; a caught error leaves the error record (packet )

body.p: , after , , , , . No public header changed. Commit 5a47d8a68.

item.p: Choice coercion ('s engine gap): XPath 4.0, 3.4.2 coerces an item that matches no alternative of a choice or union "to each of the alternatives in turn, until an alternative is found that does not result in a type error", and the item coercion rules end with a type error when the resulting item does not match the required item type (3.4.2, last rule). The engine's CHOICE took an attempt that left the item unchanged (no rule applies: xs:untypedAtomic against element(a)) as the first alternative's success, so (element(a) | xs:string) given xs:untypedAtomic("v") ended in XPTY0004 at the final match. Now an attempt succeeds only when its result matches the alternative (sxml_coercion_accept_attempt, src/evaluator_function.c); an unchanged item never does, since the CHOICE tries alternatives only for an item that matches none, so it is not matched again. A failed attempt reports the role's type error in its record and counts as an error raised above the CHOICE: the first attempt's error still stands when all fail ((xs:integer | element(a)) and "v": FORG0001). An accepted later attempt clears the first failure from the request's record, which the coercion succeeded without.

Stale error record (): reproduced with the CLI, a regex error caught and then a depth limit, declare function local:f($n) { 1 + local:f($n + 1) }; (try { matches("a", "(") } catch * { 0 }), local:f(1): exit 4 with the regex error's description and place (since the step limit is not reached, and it writes its own description, so it hid the bug except for the code and place). The catching task read the record and left it filled. New machine call sxml_evaluator_machine_forget_caught_error (src/evaluator_machine_internal.h, "Catching") clears it once a catching task has read the error and handles it: a catch clause, after its details map is made; an error kept for a finally clause (raised again from the try state); a template rule's pattern error, which is no match (XSLT 4.0, 6.5); the filter index giving up. A step limit hit between the catch and its handling keeps its own description and drops the rest. Streaming accumulators keep their caught error for the reads (19.5), as before.

Evidence: evaluator_test choices_try_every_alternative (a node alternative first, an atomic one first, a union inside a choice, maps and arrays, several items, the first attempt's error); evaluator_try_test caught_errors_leave_the_record (every step bound across a caught error: the record holds no code, value or place, and the limit's own description). debug-gcc: 437 tests pass; clang-tidy clean; no call cycle.

Conformance, release, whole, case by case against 47a1d9a33 built the same way: XP40 32,785, XQ40 46,114, XT40 12,185 passed before and after, 0 outcomes differ, no gains. The brief's figures (32,815, 46,158, 12,283) are not what HEAD gives with these drivers here. SchXslt's expand stage: output identical to s2.sch; 47,779,606,081 to 47,779,606,157 instructions (callgrind).

Left: code that tries something and drops its error without a catching task (outside the machine's catching) was not audited; such a place would leave the record filled the same way, visible only through a later failure that writes no record.
